tools.name: issue_key
tools.description: Mint a caller key (POST /keys). Bot install starts at GET https://ocr.kymac.co/llms.txt (sole advertised entry). Secret ocr_… is returned once. Prefer Authorization: Bearer; X-API-Key is an alias. First issue grants 1 free credit (credit.grant reason=first_key). Quote cost with quote_credits before

tools.name: verify_key
tools.description: Confirm IMAGE_OCR_API_KEY or Authorization: Bearer (GET /keys/verify). X-API-Key is an alias only. Does not echo the secret.

tools.name: rotate_key
tools.description: Replace the presented secret (POST /keys/rotate). Same id/caller_id and credits. New ocr_… is returned once. Old secret then fails 401 invalid_api_key. Prefer Authorization: Bearer; X-API-Key is an alias only. No ops file-edit.

tools.name: revoke_key
tools.description: Invalidate the presented secret (POST /keys/revoke). Same id is revoked; old secret then fails 401 invalid_api_key. Prefer Authorization: Bearer; X-API-Key is an alias only. No ops file-edit.

tools.name: list_credit_packs
tools.description: Prepaid TEST packs (GET /credits/packs). checkout_credits is intent only; credits grant after confirm_credits.

tools.name: checkout_credits
tools.description: Stripe TEST PaymentIntent for a pack (POST /credits/checkout). Intent only — returns credits_pending; credits are not granted or spendable until confirm_credits succeeds. Requires a caller key.

tools.name: confirm_credits
tools.description: Confirm a TEST PaymentIntent with Stripe test card pm_card_visa (POST /credits/confirm). This is when credits become granted/spendable (appends credit.purchase with credits_added). TEST only.

tools.name: quote_credits
tools.description: Dry-run cost for an op without debit (GET /credits/quote?op=ocr). Returns cost, balance, and would_succeed.

tools.name: credit_balance
tools.description: Derived prepaid balance for this caller_id (GET /credits/balance).

tools.name: credit_events
tools.description: Append-only Ledger events for this caller_id (GET /credits/events): credit.grant (first_key), credit.purchase, credit.debit, optional credit.balance_snapshot.

tools.name: ocr_extract
tools.description: Image OCR (POST /ocr). Install via GET https://ocr.kymac.co/llms.txt only. Prefer Authorization: Bearer; X-API-Key is an alias. Golden URL https://placehold.co/600x160/000000/FFFFFF/png?text=HELLO+OCR — compare ok true JSON in llms.txt. First key includes 1 free credit. Quote first with quote_credit

tools.name: health
tools.description: Public readiness (GET /health): billing (test|gated) and runner_ready. No key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: issue_key, ocr_extract · Private data: issue_key, verify_key, rotate_key, revoke_key · Public sink: issue_key, rotate_key, revoke_key, checkout_credits, confirm_credits, ocr_extract · Destructive: quote_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: issue_key, ocr_extract · Private data: issue_key, verify_key, rotate_key, revoke_key · Public sink: issue_key, rotate_key, revoke_key, checkout_credits, confirm_credits, ocr_extract · Destructive: quote_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
